title: Identification of Distinct Circulating miRNAs in Acute Ischemic Stroke Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
description: We performed comprehensive miRNA profiling of ischemic stroke patients with or without type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), an important risk factor associated with worse clinical outcomes in stroke. Serum samples were collected within 24 hrs of acute stroke diagnosis, and circulating miRNAs profiled using RNA-Seq were compared between stroke patients with T2DM (SWDM; n=92) and those without T2DM (SWoDM; n=98).
